note: USACE John Redmond Reservoir campground on the east bank of the Neosho River below the dam, off Embankment Road 5 mi north of Burlington: three loops strung along the river road (Main, Camp, Hobo). --Claude
summary: rec.gov read today: 41 electric/water sites (not 53 - the old numbering ran to 53 before a 2020 renumber), 50 A at 006-007, max 120 ft, $20-22 for 2026-28, open Apr 1-Oct 30, 14 in 30 days, showers/flush/vault/dump/water. Waterfront DOWN riverfront -> riverview (unsure).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN riverfront -> riverview (unsure after imagery; going down per the rule). The Neosho outlet channel here is ~100-200 m wide (river, not creek; below the dam, so no lake value). CAMP loop west-side pads (011, 013, 014, 016) are 20-40 m from the water but behind a belt of bank trees and brush (dense at 013-016); the north end (011-012) has a more open brown bank but 40-60 m to the water. HOBO 024-041 sit EAST of the river road, so the road is between every Hobo site and the river; MAIN is across open grass and the road from the water. The stored evidence ('RV units parked directly along the bank ~15-20 m') was read at this pin, but nothing in a leaf-on frame shows open land from a pad to the water's edge. No rec.gov 'Proximity to Water' tag on any site.
SITES: 41 (description and catalog). The stored 53 traces to the pre-2020 site numbering ('Used to be Campsite 53; changed January 2020' on HOBO 041); no non-reservable sites are listed.
HOOKUPS: live per-site API gives 50 A at MAIN 006 and 007 (reservable, not accessible), 30 A elsewhere, 15 A at HOBO 031 - stored 50 A holds (no RIDB/live split here).
EQUIPMENT: every campsite lists RV/Trailer, but most carry 'RV' max_length 0 (only Tent lengths filled); Driveway Lengths are 35-145 ft, so EKKO's 23 ft fits every site - no length concern.
PIN 38.2367,-95.7514 equals the site centroid (38.23669,-95.75139) - keep; the campground is a 1.1 km strip, loops 001-009 at the north end and 027-041 at the south.
PHONE 620-364-8613 (rec.gov) confirmed; WEBSITE https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233602 as stored. Military discount rule present (not written). SAND: none.
